title.en: Export a single test case as PDF from case detail
title.uk: Експортувати один тест-кейс у PDF зі сторінки деталей
title.fr: Exporter un cas de test en PDF depuis le détail
title.es: Exportar un caso de prueba como PDF desde el detalle
title.de: Einen Testfall aus der Detailseite als PDF exportieren

description.en: Verify Export as PDF downloads a Unicode-capable PDF with key, title, steps, and latest results.
description.uk: Перевірити, що «Експортувати PDF» завантажує PDF з ключем, назвою, кроками та останніми результатами (з підтримкою кирилиці).
description.fr: Verify Export as PDF downloads a Unicode-capable PDF with key, title, steps, and latest results.
description.es: Verify Export as PDF downloads a Unicode-capable PDF with key, title, steps, and latest results.
description.de: Verify Export as PDF downloads a Unicode-capable PDF with key, title, steps, and latest results.

precondition.en: Vulyk QA project open; at least one ready case with steps and mixed manual/CI results; user has export_reports (any project role).
precondition.uk: Відкрито проєкт Vulyk QA; є готовий кейс із кроками та змішаними результатами; користувач має export_reports.
precondition.fr: Vulyk QA project open; at least one ready case with steps and mixed manual/CI results; user has export_reports (any project role).
precondition.es: Vulyk QA project open; at least one ready case with steps and mixed manual/CI results; user has export_reports (any project role).
precondition.de: Vulyk QA project open; at least one ready case with steps and mixed manual/CI results; user has export_reports (any project role).

action.en: Open a case detail page, click Export as PDF (data-testid=case-detail-export-pdf), and open the downloaded file.
action.uk: Відкрити деталі кейсу, натиснути «Експортувати PDF» (data-testid=case-detail-export-pdf) і відкрити завантажений файл.
action.fr: Open a case detail page, click Export as PDF (data-testid=case-detail-export-pdf), and open the downloaded file.
action.es: Open a case detail page, click Export as PDF (data-testid=case-detail-export-pdf), and open the downloaded file.
action.de: Open a case detail page, click Export as PDF (data-testid=case-detail-export-pdf), and open the downloaded file.

expected_result.en: A PDF named {CASE_KEY}.pdf downloads; it shows project name, case key, title, folder path, priority, status, version, tags, automated flag, preconditions, description, numbered Action/Expected steps, linked requirements, and a Latest results table mixing manual and automated rows (newest first) with colour-blind-safe status markers; footer has export date, Vulyk version, and page number. Ukrainian/Cyrillic text in the case renders correctly when locale=uk.
expected_result.uk: Завантажується PDF з іменем {CASE_KEY}.pdf; містить назву проєкту, ключ, заголовок, шлях теки, пріоритет, статус, версію, теги, прапорець автоматизації, передумови, опис, пронумеровані кроки Дія/Очікуваний результат, повʼязані вимоги та таблицю останніх результатів (ручні+авто, новіші зверху) з маркерами статусу; у підвалі — дата експорту, версія Vulyk і номер сторінки. Кирилиця коректна за locale=uk.
expected_result.fr: A PDF named {CASE_KEY}.pdf downloads; it shows project name, case key, title, folder path, priority, status, version, tags, automated flag, preconditions, description, numbered Action/Expected steps, linked requirements, and a Latest results table mixing manual and automated rows (newest first) with colour-blind-safe status markers; footer has export date, Vulyk version, and page number. Ukrainian/Cyrillic text in the case renders correctly when locale=uk.
expected_result.es: A PDF named {CASE_KEY}.pdf downloads; it shows project name, case key, title, folder path, priority, status, version, tags, automated flag, preconditions, description, numbered Action/Expected steps, linked requirements, and a Latest results table mixing manual and automated rows (newest first) with colour-blind-safe status markers; footer has export date, Vulyk version, and page number. Ukrainian/Cyrillic text in the case renders correctly when locale=uk.
expected_result.de: A PDF named {CASE_KEY}.pdf downloads; it shows project name, case key, title, folder path, priority, status, version, tags, automated flag, preconditions, description, numbered Action/Expected steps, linked requirements, and a Latest results table mixing manual and automated rows (newest first) with colour-blind-safe status markers; footer has export date, Vulyk version, and page number. Ukrainian/Cyrillic text in the case renders correctly when locale=uk.

title.en: Bulk export selected cases as one PDF or a ZIP of PDFs
title.uk: Масовий експорт обраних кейсів одним PDF або ZIP
title.fr: Bulk export selected cases as one PDF or a ZIP of PDFs
title.es: Bulk export selected cases as one PDF or a ZIP of PDFs
title.de: Bulk export selected cases as one PDF or a ZIP of PDFs

description.en: From the Cases list, export one selected case as a single PDF and multiple selected cases as a ZIP archive of PDFs.
description.uk: Зі списку кейсів експортувати один обраний кейс як PDF і кілька — як ZIP з PDF.
description.fr: From the Cases list, export one selected case as a single PDF and multiple selected cases as a ZIP archive of PDFs.
description.es: From the Cases list, export one selected case as a single PDF and multiple selected cases as a ZIP archive of PDFs.
description.de: From the Cases list, export one selected case as a single PDF and multiple selected cases as a ZIP archive of PDFs.

precondition.en: Cases list shows at least two cases; user can select rows and has export_reports.
precondition.uk: У списку є щонайменше два кейси; можна обирати рядки; є право export_reports.
precondition.fr: Cases list shows at least two cases; user can select rows and has export_reports.
precondition.es: Cases list shows at least two cases; user can select rows and has export_reports.
precondition.de: Cases list shows at least two cases; user can select rows and has export_reports.

action.en: Select one case checkbox, click Export as PDF in the bulk bar (data-testid=case-list-export-pdf); then select two cases and export again.
action.uk: Обрати один кейс, натиснути «Експортувати PDF» на bulk-панелі (data-testid=case-list-export-pdf); потім обрати два кейси й експортувати знову.
action.fr: Select one case checkbox, click Export as PDF in the bulk bar (data-testid=case-list-export-pdf); then select two cases and export again.
action.es: Select one case checkbox, click Export as PDF in the bulk bar (data-testid=case-list-export-pdf); then select two cases and export again.
action.de: Select one case checkbox, click Export as PDF in the bulk bar (data-testid=case-list-export-pdf); then select two cases and export again.

expected_result.en: Single selection downloads one .pdf; two or more download vulyk-cases-export.zip containing one PDF per case key. Each PDF matches the single-case export content rules.
expected_result.uk: Один вибраний кейс дає один .pdf; два або більше — vulyk-cases-export.zip з PDF на кожен ключ. Зміст кожного PDF як у одиночному експорті.
expected_result.fr: Single selection downloads one .pdf; two or more download vulyk-cases-export.zip containing one PDF per case key. Each PDF matches the single-case export content rules.
expected_result.es: Single selection downloads one .pdf; two or more download vulyk-cases-export.zip containing one PDF per case key. Each PDF matches the single-case export content rules.
expected_result.de: Single selection downloads one .pdf; two or more download vulyk-cases-export.zip containing one PDF per case key. Each PDF matches the single-case export content rules.

title.en: Export PDF via GET /api/v1/cases/{id|key}/export.pdf with configurable results
title.uk: Експорт PDF через GET /api/v1/cases/{id|key}/export.pdf зі змінною кількістю результатів
title.fr: Export PDF via GET /api/v1/cases/{id|key}/export.pdf with configurable results
title.es: Export PDF via GET /api/v1/cases/{id|key}/export.pdf with configurable results
title.de: Export PDF via GET /api/v1/cases/{id|key}/export.pdf with configurable results

description.en: API export by UUID or case key respects ?results=N (default 5) and locale labels.
description.uk: API-експорт за UUID або ключем поважає ?results=N (за замовчуванням 5) і локаль підписів.
description.fr: API export by UUID or case key respects ?results=N (default 5) and locale labels.
description.es: API export by UUID or case key respects ?results=N (default 5) and locale labels.
description.de: API export by UUID or case key respects ?results=N (default 5) and locale labels.

precondition.en: Auth token or open local auth; known case key with ≥3 results.
precondition.uk: Токен або відкрита локальна auth; відомий ключ кейсу з ≥3 результатами.
precondition.fr: Auth token or open local auth; known case key with ≥3 results.
precondition.es: Auth token or open local auth; known case key with ≥3 results.
precondition.de: Auth token or open local auth; known case key with ≥3 results.

action.en: GET /api/v1/projects/{project_id}/cases/{CASE_KEY}/export.pdf?results=2&locale=uk with Authorization Bearer; also try /api/v1/cases/{uuid}/export.pdf?results=5.
action.fr: GET /api/v1/projects/{project_id}/cases/{CASE_KEY}/export.pdf?results=2&locale=uk with Authorization Bearer; also try /api/v1/cases/{uuid}/export.pdf?results=5.
action.es: GET /api/v1/projects/{project_id}/cases/{CASE_KEY}/export.pdf?results=2&locale=uk with Authorization Bearer; also try /api/v1/cases/{uuid}/export.pdf?results=5.
action.de: GET /api/v1/projects/{project_id}/cases/{CASE_KEY}/export.pdf?results=2&locale=uk with Authorization Bearer; also try /api/v1/cases/{uuid}/export.pdf?results=5.

expected_result.en: HTTP 200, Content-Type application/pdf, Content-Disposition attachment filename="{CASE_KEY}.pdf". Body starts with %PDF. Manifest/comment includes the case key and at most 2 RESULT lines for results=2; Ukrainian labels appear for locale=uk. Without permission export_reports the API returns 403 when auth is required.
expected_result.uk: HTTP 200, Content-Type application/pdf, Content-Disposition з "{CASE_KEY}.pdf". Тіло починається з %PDF. Для results=2 у маніфесті щонайбільше 2 RESULT; для locale=uk — українські підписи. Без export_reports — 403 (коли auth обовʼязкова).
